schema.text: What improvements would most encourage you to cycle more often or for longer distances?

options.text: More dedicated and physically separated cycle lanes
Better road surface quality on cycling routes
More secure bicycle parking at destinations
More secure bicycle storage near home
Reduced vehicle speeds in residential areas
Better cycle-friendly junctions and crossings
More trees and shade along cycling routes
Better street lighting on cycling routes
Access to cycle training or skills courses
Financial incentives (e.g., employer cycling allowance, subsidised bike purchase)
Nothing — I am satisfied with current conditions

it.#What improvements would most encourage: Quali miglioramenti ti incoraggerebbero maggiormente a usare la bicicletta più spesso o per distanze più lunghe?
it.#More dedicated and physically separated: Più piste ciclabili dedicate e fisicamente separate dal traffico
it.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Migliore qualità della pavimentazione lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Più parcheggi sicuri per biciclette presso le destinazioni
it.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Più spazi sicuri per custodire la bicicletta vicino a casa
it.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Riduzione della velocità dei veicoli nelle aree residenziali
it.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Incroci e attraversamenti più adatti ai ciclisti
it.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Più alberi e zone d’ombra lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Migliore illuminazione stradale lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: Accesso a corsi di formazione o abilità ciclistiche
it.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Incentivi economici, ad esempio indennità aziendali per chi usa la bicicletta o contributi per l’acquisto
it.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Nessun miglioramento — sono soddisfatto/a delle condizioni attuali

fr.#What improvements would most encourage: Quels changements vous encourageraient le plus à faire du vélo plus souvent ou sur de plus longues distances ?
fr.#More dedicated and physically separated: Davantage de pistes cyclables réservées et physiquement séparées du trafic
fr.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Une meilleure qualité de chaussée sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Davantage de stationnements sûrs pour vélos à destination
fr.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Davantage d’espaces sûrs pour ranger les vélos près du domicile
fr.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Une vitesse plus faible des véhicules dans les zones résidentielles
fr.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Des carrefours et traversées mieux adaptés aux cyclistes
fr.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Davantage d’arbres et d’ombre le long des itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Un meilleur éclairage public sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: Des cours pour apprendre ou améliorer la pratique du vélo
fr.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Des aides financières (par exemple une indemnité vélo de l’employeur ou une aide à l’achat d’un vélo)
fr.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Rien — les conditions actuelles me conviennent

de.#What improvements would most encourage: Welche Verbesserungen würden Sie am meisten dazu ermutigen, häufiger oder längere Strecken Fahrrad zu fahren?
de.#More dedicated and physically separated: Mehr eigene und baulich vom Verkehr getrennte Radwege
de.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Bessere Kreuzungen und Querungen für Radfahrer
de.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Mehr Bäume und Schatten entlang der Radstrecken
de.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Finanzielle Anreize (zum Beispiel Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber oder Förderung beim Fahrradkauf)
de.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Nichts — ich bin mit den aktuellen Bedingungen zufrieden

tr.#What improvements would most encourage: Hangi iyileştirmeler daha sık veya daha uzun mesafelerde bisiklet kullanmanızı en çok teşvik ederdi?
tr.#More dedicated and physically separated: Daha fazla özel ve fiziksel olarak trafikten ayrılmış bisiklet yolu
tr.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha iyi yol yüzeyi
tr.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Varış noktalarında daha fazla güvenli bisiklet parkı
tr.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Evin yakınında daha fazla güvenli bisiklet saklama alanı
tr.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Yerleşim bölgelerinde daha düşük araç hızları
tr.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Bisikletliler için daha iyi kavşaklar ve geçişler
tr.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha fazla ağaç ve gölge
tr.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha iyi sokak aydınlatması
tr.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: Bisiklet eğitimi veya beceri kurslarına erişim
tr.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Maddi teşvikler (örneğin işveren bisiklet desteği veya bisiklet satın alma yardımı)

fa.#What improvements would most encourage: کدام بهبودها بیشتر شما را تشویق می‌کند که بیشتر یا در مسافت‌های طولانی‌تر دوچرخه‌سواری کنید؟
fa.#More dedicated and physically separated: مسیرهای دوچرخه بیشتر و جداشده از ترافیک
fa.#Better road surface quality on cycling: کیفیت بهتر سطح خیابان در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: پارک امن‌تر و بیشتر برای دوچرخه در مقصدها
fa.#More secure bicycle storage near home: فضای امن‌تر برای نگهداری دوچرخه نزدیک خانه
fa.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: سرعت کمتر خودروها در مناطق مسکونی
fa.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: تقاطع‌ها و گذرگاه‌های بهتر برای دوچرخه
fa.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: درخت و سایه بیشتر در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#Better street lighting on cycling route: روشنایی بهتر خیابان در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: دسترسی به آموزش یا دوره مهارت دوچرخه‌سواری
fa.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: مشوق مالی (مثلاً کمک‌هزینه دوچرخه از طرف کارفرما یا کمک برای خرید دوچرخه)
fa.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: هیچ‌کدام — از شرایط فعلی راضی هستم

hu.#What improvements would most encourage: Mely fejlesztések ösztönöznék leginkább arra, hogy gyakrabban vagy hosszabb távon kerékpározzon?
hu.#More dedicated and physically separated: Több külön, fizikailag is elválasztott kerékpársáv
hu.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: Több biztonságos kerékpárparkoló az úti céloknál
hu.#More secure bicycle storage near home: Több biztonságos kerékpártároló az otthon közelében
hu.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Több fa és árnyék a kerékpáros útvonalakon
hu.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Pénzügyi ösztönzők (például munkáltatói kerékpáros támogatás vagy vásárlási támogatás)
hu.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Semmi — elégedett vagyok a jelenlegi körülményekkel

ar.#What improvements would most encourage: ما التحسينات التي ستشجعك أكثر على ركوب الدراجة بصورة أكثر أو لمسافات أطول؟
ar.#More dedicated and physically separated: المزيد من حارات الدراجات المخصصة والمنفصلة فعليًا عن حركة المرور
ar.#Better road surface quality on cycling: تحسين جودة سطح الطريق على مسارات الدراجات
ar.#More secure bicycle parking at destinat: المزيد من مواقف الدراجات الآمنة عند الوجهات
ar.#More secure bicycle storage near home: المزيد من أماكن حفظ الدراجات الآمنة بالقرب من المنزل
ar.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: خفض سرعة المركبات في المناطق السكنية
ar.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: المزيد من الأشجار والظل على طرق الدراجات
ar.#Better street lighting on cycling route: إضاءة شارع أفضل على طرق الدراجات
ar.#Access to cycle training or skills cour: إمكانية الحصول على تدريب أو دورات مهارات لركوب الدراجة
ar.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: حوافز مالية (مثل بدل دراجة من جهة العمل أو دعم لشراء دراجة)
ar.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: لا شيء — أنا راضٍ عن الظروف الحالية
